<!-- Generated by tools/build_courses.py: edit the COURSES config there. -->

Predict a number or a category from data: preprocessing, linear and logistic regression, regularization, trees, forests and boosting, Naive Bayes and time series, then two projects. Each section has **lessons**, a **quiz**, **exercises** and their **solutions**.

Each section has a zip with the lessons, the exercises and the data, so you can run everything on your computer (Python 3 with Jupyter, or [Anaconda](https://www.anaconda.com/download)). Solutions stay on this site.

## Foundations

1. **Preprocessing**: What machine learning is, and how to prepare data for a model with pandas and scikit-learn. [Lessons](01-preprocessing/lessons/what-is-machine-learning.ipynb) · [Quiz](01-preprocessing/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](01-preprocessing/exercises/titanic.ipynb) · [Solutions](01-preprocessing/solutions/titanic.ipynb)

## Regression

2. **Linear regression**: Simple and multiple linear regression, R², feature selection, and the full workflow in scikit-learn. [Lessons](02-linear-regression/lessons/linear-regression.ipynb) · [Quiz](02-linear-regression/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](02-linear-regression/exercises/california-housing.ipynb) · [Solutions](02-linear-regression/solutions/california-housing.ipynb)
3. **Regularization**: Fight overfitting with Ridge and Lasso, and tune hyperparameters with cross-validation and grid search. [Lessons](03-regularization/lessons/regularization.ipynb) · [Quiz](03-regularization/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](03-regularization/exercises/ridge-vs-lasso.ipynb) · [Solutions](03-regularization/solutions/ridge-vs-lasso.ipynb)

## Classification

4. **Logistic regression**: Predict a category with probabilities, and evaluate a classifier: confusion matrix, precision, recall, ROC. [Lessons](04-logistic-regression/lessons/logistic-regression.ipynb) · [Quiz](04-logistic-regression/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](04-logistic-regression/exercises/first-classification.ipynb) · [Solutions](04-logistic-regression/solutions/first-classification.ipynb)
5. **Decision trees and random forests**: How a tree splits the data, why it overfits, and how a forest of trees fixes it. [Lessons](05-trees-and-forests/lessons/decision-trees.ipynb) · [Quiz](05-trees-and-forests/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](05-trees-and-forests/exercises/build-a-decision-tree.ipynb) · [Solutions](05-trees-and-forests/solutions/build-a-decision-tree.ipynb)
6. **Ensemble methods**: Boosting (AdaBoost, gradient boosting, XGBoost), voting and stacking. [Lessons](06-ensemble-methods/lessons/boosting.ipynb) · [Quiz](06-ensemble-methods/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](06-ensemble-methods/exercises/titanic.ipynb) · [Solutions](06-ensemble-methods/solutions/titanic.ipynb)
7. **Naive Bayes**: Bayes' theorem and the Naive Bayes classifier, then fraud detection. [Lesson](07-naive-bayes/lessons/naive-bayes.ipynb) · [Quiz](07-naive-bayes/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](07-naive-bayes/exercises/diabetes.ipynb) · [Solutions](07-naive-bayes/solutions/diabetes.ipynb)

## Time series

8. **Time series**: Smoothing, stationarity and autocorrelation, then forecasting with Prophet. [Lessons](08-time-series/lessons/time-series.ipynb) · [Quiz](08-time-series/quiz/quiz.qmd) · [Exercises](08-time-series/exercises/electricity.ipynb) · [Solutions](08-time-series/solutions/electricity.ipynb)

## Projects

9. **Project: Walmart sales**: Predict the weekly sales of stores with linear models, and fight overfitting. [Lesson](09-walmart-sales/lessons/walmart-sales.ipynb) · [Solution](09-walmart-sales/solutions/walmart-sales.ipynb)
10. **Challenge: predict conversions**: A competition: predict who subscribes to a newsletter, submit your predictions, climb the leaderboard. [Lessons](10-conversion-challenge/lessons/the-challenge.ipynb)
